name: Club dues
summary: A ring of club members lit when they've paid dues, filling toward the goals the dues pay for.
useWhen: a club or team collecting the same dues from every member
'dues are $35 this semester', 'who hasn't paid dues yet'
dontUseWhen: splitting one bill unevenly (use a bill split)
a gift pool where amounts vary

duesCents.description: Dues per member in cents, e.g. 3500

members.description: Members of the club in total, e.g. 24

paidOutside.description: Members outside this chat who already paid, e.g. 13

names.description: Names of members outside this chat, for the ring

goals.description: Up to 3 things dues pay for, in order: label and amountCents

paid.description: Chat members who already paid, by name
